sentences.en: That evening tea was partaken of in a grim silence.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，大家在一片沉闷的沉默中喝了茶。

sentences.en: The Grim Reaper slowly extended his right arm towards Yanni.
sentences.zh: 死神缓缓地将右手伸向了雅尼。

sentences.en: Marcia looked grim when I told her the story.
sentences.zh: 我告诉她那个故事时，玛西卡看起来一脸严肃。

senses.zh: 严峻的，令人沮丧的；严厉的，冷酷的；可怕的，阴森的
